newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures start higher, then slip.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures start higher, then slip.

text.p: CME lumber futures opened firmer on support from a recent stronger tone to cash lumber, but prices quickly slipped as buyers were reluctant to keep pushing prices higher, traders said.
At 0928 CDT, lumber stood $1.50 per thousand board feet lower to 43.50 higher with May off most at $384.00 and July off 40.20 at $380.00 per tbf.

Futures hold a discount to cash lumber prices and recent gains in cash lumber supported futures initially, but follow hrough demand was lacking as the market looked due for a correction, floor sources said. Futures have risen over $32 the past couple of weeks, they noted.
